title: Close-out CI read errors are typed as PR refusals (closeout_pr_unmet) in both gates
body: When the forge cannot READ CI on the PR (network, credential, rate limit), both the 0iz admission and the new sqx close gate refuse with RefusedCloseoutPR ("no PR, or one the forge could not open or read"), even though the PR exists and the repair is the forge's reachability, not the PR. The repo's own doctrine (Appendix A #9) is that each failure class gets its own type; a distinct reason (e.g. closeout_ci_unreadable) would send the next repair at the network/credential instead of at the PR. Deliberately left as-is in this tick to match the admission's existing convention; changing both in one later tick keeps the two gates symmetrical.
